info.name: x402-agentic-text-pipeline
info.description: A 5-tier text utility hub engineered for autonomous AI developer agents. Provides structural data ingestion, text compression, financial sentiment indexing, multilingual translation layers, and metadata keyword classification wrapped in onchain x402 monetization gates.

tools.name: web_scraper
tools.description: Strips heavy layout components from HTML webpages and extracts clean, markdown-optimized string content.

tools.name: text_summarizer
tools.description: Compresses text documents down into brief sentence snapshots to cut down context window token weights.

tools.name: crypto_sentiment_analyzer
tools.description: Performs keywords velocity indexing over textual string inputs to output market momentum velocity indicators.

tools.name: multilingual_translator
tools.description: Translates text streams natively into dynamic localized regional idioms (es, fr, de) to normalize foreign scrapes.

tools.name: keyword_extractor_classifier
tools.description: Extracts high-density onchain crypto keywords and automated tracking hashtags to classify data blocks without an LLM call.

text.description: The raw string block to extract taxonomy keywords from.
